summary.intent: Plan and execute phase 49 (shared-folder intra-share move + useFolderNavigation unwrap consolidation) across 6 requirements, then run the full PR-QA pipeline (simplify, security reviews, CodeRabbit CLI) before pushing and opening a PR.
summary.outcome: Phase 49 fully planned (5 plans, 3 waves, 6 requirements including a scope expansion for batch+drag move parity) and executed with all gates green. Simplify pass completed with a correctness commit (cycle guards, clearSelection-on-success). Crypto security review completed with one MEDIUM fix applied (folderKey zeroing). Session ended during the general appsec review, before CodeRabbit CLI, push, and PR creation.

repo: reencryptFileMetadataForFolderChange (reencrypt.ts:49) is fully key-agnostic — takes raw key bytes with no owner/recipient distinction, reusable verbatim for the shared-folder case
share_keys entries are keyed by itemId (file UUID), not parent folder — file keys do NOT need re-registration after a folder move
adoptSharedFolderResult must only be called once for the source result; calling it for the dest would corrupt the sharedFolderTree projection (dest is re-loaded on next navigateToSubfolder)
sdkCore.moveItem throws 'An item with this name already exists in destination' on collision (sdk-core/src/folder/index.ts:346) — no auto-rename needed
@internal on ensureFolderLoaded is documentation-only; CipherBoxClient is already exported and can be called directly from the web without a new public alias
File IPNS key for re-encryption must come from share_keys keyType:'file-ipns', NOT FilePointer.ipnsPrivateKeyEncrypted (owner-wrapped; recipient cannot decrypt it)
SDK dist/ is gitignored — CI rebuilds it; new SDK methods appear in client.d.ts (not index.d.ts which is a barrel re-export), so consumers do see them
Web package has no 'typecheck' npm script — use tsc -b directly
Intel API surface extractor (gsd-tools) is unpopulated and returns empty output — omit from planner prompt, RESEARCH.md carries all symbol refs
Private-vault batch move loops single-item client.moveItem (no dedicated SDK batch method); drag move is multi-select-aware in FileListItem — both are clean analogs for the shared side
isExternalFileDrag (from useDropUpload) and DragItem (from FileListItem) exist as shared helpers — SharedFolderRow should import rather than re-implement them

code.finding: enumerateSharedSubtree did not zero per-iteration folderKey after use, leaving plaintext AES folder keys live in heap across the DFS traversal — fixed with try/finally zeroing

runWrite swallowed errors and returned void, causing batchMoveItemsHandler to always clear selection regardless of success/failure — changed runWrite to return boolean so clearSelection only fires on success

Missing descendant/cycle guard — a recipient could move a folder into its own descendant creating a tree cycle; fixed by adding isNodeDisabled computed from parentId returned by enumerateSharedSubtree

Plan-checker blockers: two were RESEARCH.md doc-formatting nits (resolution markers missing from open questions); one was real — REQ-3 had no dedicated web unit test in plan 49-03's verification section
SharedFolderClient Pick allowlist needed moveInSharedFolder and enumerateSharedSubtree added — only listed the 7 Phase 48 methods
Appeared in the PR diff (+9 lines) but was not in any plan's files_modified list — needs investigation to confirm it's intentional wiring vs. unplanned side-effect

workflow: Sequential wave execution (no worktrees) is more reliable than parallel worktrees for autonomous/AFK GSD runs — the parallel-worktree merge-back protocol is error-prone to hand-drive
After adding new public SDK methods, must rebuild SDK dist before web typecheck or the cross-package dist-staleness will cause false tsc failures in wave 2+
gsd-tools is not on PATH for planner-revision subagents — plan revisions cannot self-commit; orchestrator must commit them after the subagent returns
prettier hook reformats committed files, so any planned edits to recently-committed files must re-read the file first (the reformatted version) before applying edits
CodeRabbit: run CLI review before creating the PR; after PR creation CodeRabbit auto-posts a GitHub review; use /resolve-pr-reviews to address inline comments

Disable commit.gpgsign locally (git config --local commit.gpgsign false) for AFK sessions to prevent 1Password signer from wedging during automated commits — must re-enable before merge if repo enforces signed commits
GSD plan-checker iteration 1 false positives (doc-formatting nits) are worth fixing directly in the docs rather than re-spawning the full planner — much cheaper
Simplify pass should apply behavior-preserving quality fixes and defer behavior-changing correctness issues to a dedicated commit labeled as such (not skip them entirely)

friction: commit.gpgsign=true globally caused 1Password signer to wedge during automated commits — required manual session-level override before proceeding AFK
Web package missing a 'typecheck' npm script required discovery of the correct tsc -b invocation
SDK index.d.ts barrel re-export structure caused initial confusion about whether new methods were visible to consumers (they were in client.d.ts)
gsd-tools not on PATH inside planner-revision subagent — planner couldn't commit its own revisions, requiring orchestrator to commit them manually
prettier pre-commit hook reformatted client.ts after commit, breaking the queued edit — had to re-read the file before applying the security fix
unwrapKey was not imported as a named binding in the enumerate test file, requiring an import addition before the zeroing assertion could be written
Plan-checker flagged two RESEARCH.md doc-formatting issues as blockers — minor overhead but required an extra revision round
